# DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 32G96G GGUF — moved

The GGUF files are not in this repository. They are in
**[zephel01/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731-IQ2_M-32G96G-GGUF](https://huggingface.co/zephel01/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731-IQ2_M-32G96G-GGUF)**
(folder `L97`, for a 32 GB GPU + 96 GB RAM), with the model card, the speeds and the checks.

`./setup-deepseek.sh --quant 32G96G` in [Abyss](https://github.com/zephel01/Abyss) downloads from there.
